summary: Comprehensive testing of P0 bug fixes for Rhino Drishti Elite OSINT Platform. Both critical bugs are FIXED: (1) Custom PDF Brief now returns 200 with valid PDF (fpdf2 effective_w fix working), (2) Embeddings backfill endpoint returns 200 (OPENAI_API_KEY fix working - actual embedding fails with 429 quota as expected). All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend Dashboard, Daily Brief, and Intelligence Feed pages all working correctly.

custom_pdf_500_error.fix_details: Changed fpdf2 cell(0,...) to use explicit effective_w calculations in _generate_custom_pdf()

embeddings_401_error.fix_details: Changed embedding_service.py to use OPENAI_API_KEY instead of EMERGENT_LLM_KEY
embeddings_401_error.note: Actual embedding generation will fail with 429 (quota exceeded) but endpoint doesn't crash

critical_code_review_comments: P0 Custom PDF fix is correct - using effective_w = pdf.w - pdf.l_margin - pdf.r_margin for all cell/multi_cell calls
P0 Embeddings fix is correct - embedding_service.py now uses OPENAI_API_KEY from environment
Semantic search gracefully returns empty results when no embeddings exist
30-day retention window correctly shows 472 of 532 total items
All UI components have proper data-testid attributes for testing
test_credentials: No credentials needed - app has no auth system
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data (532 intelligence items, 472 within 30-day retention window)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both P0 bugs are fixed and verified: (1) Custom PDF Brief at POST /api/intelligence/custom-brief now returns valid PDF using explicit effective_w calculations, (2) Embeddings backfill at POST /api/embeddings/backfill returns 200 using OPENAI_API_KEY (actual embedding fails with 429 quota but endpoint doesn't crash).
